subject: English
description: Reading comprehension: factual + inferential + vocab + tone questions

questions.stem: Passage: 'The Sun is the closest star to Earth, ~150 million km away. Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach us. The Sun is mainly hydrogen + helium and produces energy by nuclear fusion.' Q: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
questions.explanation: Direct factual lookup from passage: '8 minutes'. Always check the passage first. Distractors are time-unit traps — common SSC RC trap — same number, different unit.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Passage: 'Mahatma Gandhi led India's freedom struggle through non-violence. His Salt March in 1930 challenged British salt tax and inspired millions.' Q: What method did Gandhi use?
questions.explanation: Passage explicitly says 'through non-violence'. Distractors are alternative methods not from the passage. RC question often phrased to misdirect to plausible-but-wrong methods.
questions.subject: English

questions.stem: Passage: 'Climate change is one of the gravest challenges of our time. Rising temperatures are melting glaciers, raising sea levels, and disrupting weather patterns. Action is urgent.' Q: TONE of the passage is best described as:
questions.explanation: Words 'gravest', 'rising', 'melting', 'disrupting', 'urgent' all carry SERIOUS + URGENT mood. RC tone questions look for emotion-coloured words (signals of attitude) rather than facts. Other tones to recognise: optimistic, pessimistic, sarcastic, ironic, neutral, critical, sympathetic.
